kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انغرزت (form VII)
# اِنْغَرَزْتُ (inḡaraztu) /in.ɣa.raz.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
# اِنْغَرَزْتَ (inḡarazta) /in.ɣa.raz.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
# اِنْغَرَزْتِ (inḡarazti) /in.ɣa.raz.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْغَرَزَ (inḡaraza)
# اِنْغَرَزَتْ (inḡarazat) /in.ɣa.ra.zat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
